Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Here is a proposal for you to review:

- Venue: the Studio, for 4 hours. It holds up to 12 people, so it fits your group of 10, and Wi-Fi is included.
- Catering: one coffee break for each of the 10 attendees.



| Item | Detail | Price |
|---|---|---:|
| Studio (V1) | 4 hours | €240 |
| Coffee break (S1) | 10 people x €8 | €80 |
| **Total** | | **€320** |
| Budget | | €320 |
| Difference | | exactly on budget |



The package comes within your budget.

Assumption: you didn't mention accessibility, so I have assumed that nobody needs wheelchair access. The Studio can only be reached by stairs. If anyone in your group needs a route without stairs, please tell me. The Loft is wheelchair accessible and takes up to 24 people, and I can price it for you.

Please also note:
- Bookings are for 4-hour blocks only. There is no longer-duration option.
- Availability has to be checked separately for your date. Nothing is held at this stage.
- The listed prices are fixed.

Please get in touch if you'd like to change anything or go ahead.

Kind regards

reasons: All stated requirements are met, subject to the listed assumptions.
assumptions: Accessibility not stated: assumed no wheelchair access is needed. The Studio is stairs-only.

Dates always need a separate availability check; nothing is booked or held.
No discounts of any kind are available.
